confirmed.statement: The submitted template ZIP contains a persisted backend/data/db.json from the generation run instead of a clean seed. Delete me 2.3.1 and Delete me 2.3.3 are already trashed, while the API excludes trashed notes from the default listing, so the official home-page locator cannot find them.
evidence: template/backend/server.js:64-73 loads an existing db.json and only calls seedStore when the file is absent or corrupt
template/backend/data/db.json contains both target notes with trashed=true and deletedAt timestamps
template/backend/server.js:130-132 filters trashed notes from GET /api/notes
template/backend/server.js:32-34 defines both notes as clean in seedStore
confirmed.boundary: This is a template-state contamination defect; it is distinct from the Octos timeout/proxy failures recorded by Phase 3.

confirmed.statement: The initial grid-mode toggle exposes the action name Grid view, but the official default-grid contract searches for the available List view action.
evidence: template/frontend/src/app.js:12 initializes viewMode to grid
template/frontend/src/index.html:26 gives #view-toggle aria-label=Grid view
template/frontend/src/app.js:720-724 changes the label to List view only after the first click
REQ-5.2 searches for /list view/i before clicking
confirmed.boundary: The grid layout itself is the default; the confirmed defect is the initial accessible action label.

strong_candidate.statement: Mutation handlers start loadNotes/loadLabels without awaiting them, while the official helpers immediately navigate, close dialogs, or read the filtered DOM. Concurrent renderNotes calls clear and rebuild #notes-area, which can detach a hovered card or leave stale label state visible.
evidence: template/frontend/src/app.js:328-340 calls loadNotes after archive without returning or awaiting the promise
template/frontend/src/app.js:444-470 updates a label and starts loadNotes asynchronously
template/frontend/src/app.js:633-651 starts loadLabels and immediately renderLabelManager after rename
template/frontend/src/app.js:187-190 clears #notes-area before every render
REQ-2.5.4 reports the resolved card detached during hover and REQ-2.7.2 reports the removed note still present
strong_candidate.limitation: The supplied report does not include a browser trace sufficient to prove the exact race on a clean seed.

strong_candidate.statement: Archive controls are rendered from each note, but the persisted ZIP state is not a clean archive fixture and the archive mutation is followed by an unawaited reload. This combines fixture contamination with a render-lifecycle risk for the archive/unarchive flow.
evidence: template/frontend/src/app.js:290-300 renders Archive or Unarchive from n.archived
template/frontend/src/app.js:328-341 performs PATCH then invokes loadNotes without awaiting it
template/backend/data/db.json contains generated-run state rather than the seedStore fixture
strong_candidate.limitation: Travel plans 2.5.4 is present and unarchived in the supplied db.json, so the final hover timeout cannot be attributed to fixture state alone.

strong_candidate.statement: The settings trigger and the nested Settings menu item share the same accessible name, while the official helper resolves a button before a menuitem. A second Settings click can close the menu instead of opening #settings-detail, leaving Save hidden.
evidence: template/frontend/src/index.html:27 defines the visible #settings-btn with aria-label=Settings
template/frontend/src/index.html:28-29 defines a hidden role=menu menu containing a role=menuitem also named Settings
template/frontend/src/app.js:697-709 toggles the menu and removes hidden from #settings-detail only when the menu item handler runs
REQ-4.2 reports #settings-save resolved but hidden
strong_candidate.limitation: No browser runtime was available for a bounded clean-seed replay in this recovery environment, so this remains a strong candidate rather than confirmed.

strong_candidate.statement: The color mutation calls loadNotes and rebuilds the notes area asynchronously; the visual helper captures a text locator's bounding box immediately around that lifecycle. A zero or stale box can produce the reported empty screenshot clip.
evidence: template/frontend/src/app.js:404-437 PATCHes the color and then calls loadNotes
template/frontend/src/app.js:187-190 clears and rebuilds the notes area
REQ-2.6.1 reports page.screenshot with an empty or outside clip after resolving the note
strong_candidate.limitation: The screenshot helper and final browser trace are external to the template ZIP, so the exact box geometry is not proven.

unknown: Whether the REQ-2.3.2 missing undo control was caused by the same persisted-state contamination, a toast timing race, or both.
Whether the REQ-2.5.1 Archived locator failure was caused by the concurrent render race or by the official helper observing the wrong accessible action.
The exact clean-seed browser DOM and bounding boxes for REQ-2.6.1 and REQ-4.2 could not be replayed because no Playwright runtime was available in this environment.
The upstream proxy_error for REQ-2.6.2 and Octos turn timeouts remain confirmed Phase 3 execution failures, but they are not product-template root causes for the other final tests.

accepted_and_confirmed: The official web-keep suite identity was correct for this Run.
The final result is 21/32 with ten timeouts and one screenshot assertion failure.
Octos timeout/proxy events and the runner not_verified list are execution/process evidence, not a passing signal.
qualified: Persisted generated-run data is a confirmed template-state defect; async DOM replacement, settings role ambiguity, and screenshot timing remain strong candidates.
No conclusion from another Keep or BookStack Run was merged.
not_a_cause: No OOM or global time-budget exhaustion was evidenced.
No claim is made that Stage 5, a platform rerun, an upload, or an official-test change occurred.

bounded_recommendations: Reset or omit backend/data/db.json at build/startup so every official run begins from seedStore, then verify fixture titles and label names through GET /api/notes and GET /api/labels.
Expose List view as the initial grid-mode toggle action name, and keep the label synchronized with the mode.
Serialize mutation refreshes or update local state in place before allowing navigation, hover, or filtered assertions to continue.
Give the settings trigger and menu item distinct accessible names or roles so the official resolver cannot toggle the wrong control.
Run each affected official spec with workers=1 on a clean seed before any broad repair pass.
